name: Familiar Cohort
body:
Your familiar is also your most trusted adventuring ally.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (arcana, nature, or religion) 7 ranks, Improved Familiar, effective wizard level 7, ability to acquire a new familiar.

Benefit: You gain a special cohort instead of a new familiar.

This must be a monster with an indicated cohort level and able to become a familiar, such as a cassisian or a pseudodragon. The cohort’s level is calculated as per your character level; the monster gains empathic link and share spells at its 1st class level, deliver touch spells at 3rd level, and scry on familiar at 13th level.

Special: This feat counts as the Leadership feat for the purposes of prerequisites. A character cannot have both Leadership and Familiar Cohort.
